goal: Each team lead uses Claude to draft the weekly team report from the team's task tracker and checks every line against it before sending.

nodes.skill: Draft the weekly team report from the task tracker with Claude and check every line against the tracker before sending it.
Draft the weekly report with Claude from a tracker export.
Check each line of Claude's draft against the tracker export and flag every line the export does not support, naming the tracker row it was checked against.

floor.detail: Profile: "Team leads who already write the weekly report by hand" - judging whether a report line matches the team's logged work is what they already do; the new part (having a Claude draft to check) is linked as prereq N2, not duplicated.

data.what: Tracker export the draft is checked against (real work)
data.quote: Tracker exports are read-only copies of real data; nothing is written back to the tracker.

data.what: Tracker file the draft is checked against (practice)
data.quote: Practice reports use the sample tracker file supplied by the presenter.

nodes.skill: Ask Claude for a first draft by stating what the document is, who reads it and what it must contain.

floor.detail: Profile says "New to Claude", but the inputs do not name which Claude product or surface participants use; any finer step (opening it, where to type) would assume one. Reported as a gap.

claims.text: Claude produces a written first draft from a plain-language request.

nodes.skill: Give Claude a tracker export as the source it must draft the report from.

floor.detail: The inputs do not state the export's file format or how it reaches Claude (attached file or pasted text), so no finer step can be justified. Reported as gaps.

data.what: Tracker export used as the draft's source (real work)
data.quote: Tracker exports are read-only copies of real data; nothing is written back to the tracker.

data.what: Tracker file used as the draft's source (practice)
data.quote: Practice reports use the sample tracker file supplied by the presenter.

claims.text: Claude can take a tracker export, supplied as an attached file or pasted text, as source material in a conversation.

nodes.skill: Revise Claude's draft by telling it what to change and reading the revised version.

floor.detail: Profile: "Team leads who already write the weekly report by hand" - deciding what a report needs changed is existing skill; asking Claude is linked as prereq N4, not duplicated.

claims.text: Claude revises its own earlier draft in the same conversation when told what to change.

gaps.detail: The goal says "checks every line" but the glossary does not define what counts as a line of the weekly report (sentence, bullet, figure). N3 depends on it; not defined here.
Used in criterion C1 and the constraints; the glossary defines "task tracker" but not the export (its format or contents). N3 and N5 depend on it.
The glossary marks it UNRESOLVED ("the tracker's status values are not yet listed"). Not used in the goal, weekly goals or constraints, so no node depends on it.
The inputs do not name which Claude product or surface participants use. N4 and N5 stop splitting here, and their product claims carry verify: true.

set_aside.reason: Delivery constraint (time); the tree is about capability only, so it does not shape any node.
